findings.passage: I still get carded for buying alcohol. I'm 42. Voting is the most important thing we do as Americans. Of course it should require showing ID.
findings.note: His answer on a voter guide questionnaire (2022 District 2 House race) to the statement that people should be able to vote without photo identification; he marked Strongly Disagree.

findings.passage: There are so many good election integrity measures I've supported it's hard to say here. But Voter ID is the biggest.
findings.note: His answer on the same questionnaire to what laws he would propose to change present voting practices.

findings.passage: As your Representative, I will ensure that you can be confident in your vote once again by passing common-sense election integrity bills that will make it harder to cheat.
findings.note: Campaign site section on restoring confidence in elections. It does not name voter ID or citizenship. Page date not shown; the page also lists 2026 bill items.
